rationales: NaCl solubility increases slightly with temperature, so this option also fits the literal wording.
Ce₂(SO₄)₃ becomes less soluble as temperature rises.
Li₂SO₄ becomes less soluble as temperature rises.

Transition elements are metals, so this is not the usual pairing for ionic compounds.
Halogens are nonmetals that commonly form ionic compounds with metals.
Noble gases are generally unreactive and do not commonly form ionic compounds with metals.
Metalloids are not the expected partners in this basic rule for forming ionic compounds.
At constant pressure, increasing a gas's temperature does not increase its density.
Increasing pressure compresses a gas and increases its density, assuming temperature is constant.
At constant volume, density remains unchanged if the amount of gas is unchanged.
Constant pressure alone does not imply that gas density increases.
Milk is a colloid and is heterogeneous at the microscopic level.
Ink is commonly treated as a uniform solution in this type of classification.
Milk of magnesia is a suspension and is heterogeneous, so it also fits.
Sugar solution is a homogeneous mixture.
Dust is not a gas dispersed in a solid.
Dust particles are solids dispersed through air, which is a gas.
Dust particles are not solids dispersed in a liquid.
Dust particles are not liquids dispersed in a solid.
486 kJ/mol is not the accepted first ionization energy of sodium.
Sodium's first ionization energy is approximately 496 kJ/mol.
738 kJ/mol is much higher than sodium's first ionization energy.
590 kJ/mol is not the accepted first ionization energy of sodium.
Carbon's atomic number is not 9.
Carbon's atomic number is not 8.
Carbon's atomic number is not 7.
Carbon has 6 protons, so its atomic number is 6.
A cation has a positive charge.
An atom is electrically neutral when it has equal numbers of protons and electrons.
An anion is a negatively charged ion.
A radical is a species with an unpaired electron, not a name for every negatively charged atom.
The M shell can hold more than 2 electrons.
The M shell can hold more than 8 electrons.
For the M shell, n = 3 and the maximum is 2n² = 18 electrons.
The M shell holds at most 18 electrons, not 32.
Horizontal rows in the modern periodic table are periods.
Groups are the vertical columns of the periodic table.
Noble gases are a family of elements, not horizontal rows.
Transition elements are a category of elements, not horizontal rows.
Ice is less dense than liquid water, not denser.
Crystallinity alone does not explain why ice floats.
Water is denser than ice, so ice floats.
Random molecular motion is not the reason ice floats.
Sodium does not produce a brick-red flame.
Sodium's flame is not brilliant white.
Brilliant yellow is a standard description of sodium's flame.
Golden yellow is also a standard description of sodium's flame, so the color choices overlap.

C₂H₄ contains a carbon-carbon double bond.
C₂H₂ contains a carbon-carbon triple bond.
C₆H₆ is conventionally represented with delocalized bonding, not a carbon-carbon triple bond.
Air is generally a homogeneous mixture of gases.
Rock is heterogeneous because its composition varies from place to place.
Ice cream has multiple dispersed phases and is heterogeneous, so it also fits.
Gasoline is generally treated as a homogeneous mixture.
The mass number does not include electrons.
The mass number does not include electrons.
The mass number is the total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus.
Protons alone give the atomic number, not the mass number.
